title: Trump signs bill returning whole milk to school lunches
summary: Move allowing whole and 2% milk to be served in cafeterias overturns Obama-era limits to higher-fat milk options Whole milk is heading back to school cafeterias across the country after Donald Trump signed a bill on Wednesday overturning Obama-era limits on higher-fat milk options. Non-dairy drinks such as fortified soy milk may also be on the menu in the coming months following adoption of the Whole Milk for Healthy Kids Act, which cleared Congress in the fall.
